narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On July 19, 2024, at approximately 2210 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject walking along the shoulder of Interstate 75 near Erie, Michigan, after a motorist reported a pedestrian on the highway. The agents stopped to check on his welfare.
The subject told agents that he is from Ecuador and does not have permission to be in the United States. He showed them an Ecuadorian national identity card.
ENTRY:
He said that he made the journey north through Mexico by bus and that he got across the river near Del Rio, Texas, in the spring of 2021, walking at night with a small group.
He said he worked in Texas and Tennessee before coming to Michigan last month.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear and released on his own recognizance.
